bullets.text: CR 97.4 with catastrophe losses of $430M (6.6 pts); Property catastrophe reinsurance limited homeowners' losses to $50M for Hurricane Irma; YTD CR 94.2; NPW +18% Q3 (+14% YTD).
Deployed full-time catastrophe team in full force and almost 1,300 reservists; closed just over 95% of Harvey and 90% of Irma vehicle claims, plus about 95% of Harvey and 70% of Irma property claims.
PIF grew 11% in Agency and Direct auto, 16% in Property, and 4% in Commercial Auto; Robinson PIF grew about 30% YOY; trailing 12-month total auto PLE reached a new all-time high (+5%).
Snapshot mobile app rolled out to 41 states and DC; over half of new Direct UBI customers use mobile app when available; logged 11M+ trips and 116M miles driven since introduction.
Direct auto new applications grew 25% YOY in Q3; advertising costs stayed on pace with the first half, though media spend rose significantly YOY reflecting 2H 2016 cost reduction efforts.

Commercial Lines rate levels viewed favorably amid ongoing state and coverage adjustments; new business volume was strong, especially in September; believes new segmentation and underwriting are helping a lot.
Launching UBI program for Federal Motor Carriers in December offering 3–18% discounts; designed as a device-agnostic approach compatible with multiple Electronic Logging Device (ELD) vendors.
Portfolio FTE total return 1.1% for Q3 (equities 4.3%, fixed income 0.7%); YTD FTE return 4.2%; expected Federal Reserve rate hikes in December and 2018 anticipated to benefit yields over time.

Emphasized claims Purpose of connecting daily work to broader objectives; expressed companywide Pride as employees accomplished results for customers while many simultaneously dealt with storm damage to their own homes and vehicles.

Agency channel experienced ongoing gains in bundled volume across Platinum states; Direct channel improved HomeQuote Explorer yield through mobile quote and online buy features; both channels showed strength in total auto PLE.
